exposure: elastosonography parameters (strain ratio, myometrial shear wave velocity, scar hardness)
cohort: The study included 61 patients with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) and a separate control group of 61 patients, all between 6 and 12 weeks of gestation.
finding: Elastosonography parameters (strain ratio, myometrial shear wave velocity, and scar hardness) were significant diagnostic factors for Cesarean scar pregnancy.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections did not significantly correlate with elastosonography findings.
